title: Copper Companions
description: Copper golems now can pick up items and play music.
body:
![Logo text that says 'COPPER COMPANIONS'](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45ce73ee934c4ed1c7eb0454375358143fda5181_0.webp)
=================

Copper golems can pick up items and play music.

![This GIF shows a Minecraft scene on a grassy island surrounded by water. A Copper Golem walks across the grass toward a floating, spinning diamond sword. The Golem reaches the sword and picks it up. The scene loops continuously.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8669bb1ddeea2b648d623abfc38a3ff697f4d8b.gif)

Features
--------

- Picks up items
- Puts music discs in jukeboxes

![ This image shows a Minecraft  scene on a small grassy island surrounded by water. In the background, a Copper Golem is walking or running across the grass. In the foreground, an emerald and a bone are lying on the sand near the edge of the grass. The sunlight reflects off the water, and part of a wooden structure with chests is visible in the distance on the right.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cdebb4e4ea05acaa29feef79133aa91a8bdc425d_0.webp)

Configuration
-------------

Configure via config/coppercompanions-common.toml:

    [copper_companions]
    searchRadius = 16
    searchHeight = 3
    pickupAgeThreshold = 20
    pickupRange = 2.0
    maxStuckTicks = 40
    maxRetries = 2

Requirements
------------

- Minecraft 1.21.9+  
- Minecraft Forge 59.0.1+

Installation
------------

1. Download the JAR file
2. Place in your mods/ folder  
3. Restart Minecraft

Building
--------

    .\gradlew.bat build
